parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the ACL.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~27584~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun slb delete-access-control-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --acl-id acl-bp1l0kk4gxce43kz000000 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
